**Before Commute Rhythm (5 minutes):**

*   **Mindful Scooter Check:** Before you head out, take 60 seconds to visually inspect your scooter, ensuring everything is secure. As you do, focus on your breath – inhale deeply, exhale slowly. This shifts your focus away from work-related thoughts.
*   **Energizing Playlist Prep:** Select a playlist of upbeat, familiar songs you enjoy. This will be your soundtrack for a calmer ride.

**Mid-Commute Micro-Activity (During your scooter ride):**

*   **Rhythmic Breathing & Posture Check:** Every few minutes, consciously check your posture on the scooter – shoulders relaxed, core engaged. Coordinate your breathing with your scooter’s rhythm. Inhale for 4 counts as you push off, exhale for 4 counts as you glide. This combines gentle core engagement with mindful breathing, mirroring the energy of your group fitness classes but adapted for your commute.

**After Commute Rhythm (10 minutes):**

*   **Scooter Shutdown & Grounding:** Once you reach your destination, take a moment to park your scooter and stand still for 60 seconds. Feel your feet firmly planted on the ground. Notice the sensations – the texture, the temperature.
*   **Music Transition:** Switch to a calming playlist – instrumental music, nature sounds, or anything that signals a shift from “work mode” to “relaxation mode.”
*   **Gentle Stretch Sequence (5 minutes):** Do a short sequence of stretches focusing on areas likely to be tense from riding – shoulders, neck, back. Think of it as a mini-version of your group fitness warm-up, but at a much gentler pace. Simple stretches like shoulder rolls, neck tilts, and torso twists will do the trick.
